# CANDIDATE: MIDDAY_STRUCTURE_SHIFT_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis
After the morning churn, a fresh higher low forming and breaking above the prior swing high signals resumption of the day’s uptrend. This captures intraday trend continuation after initial noise, exploiting the tendency for strong trends to resume post-lunch when institutional participation increases.

## Mechanism
After 11:00 EST, identify the most recent swing low and swing high using a 10‑bar pivot lookback; if price makes a higher low (current low > prior low) and then breaks above the prior swing high with a close > that high and volume > average volume of the last 20 bars, enter long at the close of the breakout bar. Exit: Stop at the recent higher low; target 1.5R; if price reaches 1R, switch to a premium stop (trail 10% from high) for the runner. Regime filters: VIX <22 and time between 11:00‑14:00 EST (midday), avoiding first hour and last half hour of session.
